name: Volcano Goddess

features.name: Choice of bonus
features.description: Pick Respins or Free Spins when six scatters land.

features.name: Sticky scatter respins
features.description: Collect money values; filling the grid wins the Grand.

review:
Jackpots plus scatter collecting. Wilds can randomly start a bonus with four jackpots worth up to 5,000x, and scatters carry values up to 1,000x.

Six or more scatters let you choose: Respins, with sticky gold and green scatters collecting money values (a full grid wins the 5,000x Grand), or Free Spins, where gold scatters act as wilds and pay the trigger scatters' values. 96.49% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
